The living area opens towards the quieter side of the building, with views across the adjacent pedestrian zone, mature trees and a children’s playground. Thanks to its orientation, the living space benefits from abundant natural light, particularly in the afternoon.

The semi-open kitchen is fitted with built-in Bosch appliances and integrates seamlessly into the living area. A generously sized utility room provides additional storage space and practical functionality.

The balcony extends the living space outdoors and offers ample room for a comfortable seating area. From here, there is a view towards the Berliner Ensemble.

Combining Philippe Starck’s distinctive design, peaceful courtyard-facing bedrooms, a bright and inviting living area, a generous balcony and the extensive concierge, wellness and fitness facilities of YOO Berlin, this apartment offers sophisticated urban living with an exceptional level of comfort and service. title: Living Close to the Kurfürstendamm: Modern apartment in the rear building with balcony
description:

Simply move in, settle down and feel at home – no extensive renovation work is required.
